from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics for a single company needed to compute the Health Score."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    
    # Operating Cash Flow
    operating_cash_flow_amount: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of net cash from operating activities")
    operating_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the cash flow amount (e.g., 'millions', 'thousands')")
    
    # Net Income
    net_income_amount: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of consolidated net income")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the net income amount (e.g., 'millions', 'thousands')")
    
    # Total Assets
    total_assets_amount: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of total assets")
    total_assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the total assets amount (e.g., 'millions', 'thousands')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancials]
